title: CppCon 2017: Kate Gregory “10 Core Guidelines You Need to Start Using Now”
summary: Kate Gregory's CppCon 2017 talk picks ten highlights from the C++ Core Guidelines and shows examples and benefits for each. It is aimed at C++ developers of any experience level who have not read the full guidelines.
why: Recommended as the condensed tl;dr of the C++ Core Guidelines and as a route into modern C++.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I recommend the tl;dr version from Kate Gregory at CppCon 2017
